posts.author: DeadManDan98
posts.body:
Just gotten back to working on the fan game for MediEvil. It's been a while since I was on here and come on, we all know that you missed little ol' me being here for help.
So starting off is
Update One
.
I have edited the sprites here a little and I have yet to test them out on the RPG maker.
Update Two
The screenshot you are seeing is a prototype version of the gate. I am on GIMP to add shadows to it right now and if you want to see the full sprite sheet, feel free to ask in the comments.
Update Three
I have made the first three MediEvil OCs that were a part of a MediEvil fanfiction on AO3 but I will save that story on a later date whenever I feel free to share that with you.
They are the characters playing in the demo as of right now, but wait, it's not over yet.
I have also had the time to make emotes for each character here. As I am writing this, I am going to show you guys the sheets of each one here too.
Update Four
I have been planning on doing a texture for Dan's Crypt and make it accurate to the first level of MediEvil and then I will worry about making the game fancy later.
This is the level that I need to work on. From the
MediEvil Wiki
.
Who can't say that GIMP can't come in handy, so there's that.
All being said, I need to redesign the level here to have it legit to this map here so if there're any tips that I should try do please let me know right away.
